enhanced.description: Greatly increased reload, stability, and handling when targets are in close proximity.

enhanced.name: Stats for All

perks.name: Wellspring
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.

enhanced.name: Wellspring
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.

perks.name: Impulse Amplifier
perks.description: Massively increases projectile velocity, increases reload speed.

enhanced.name: Impulse Amplifier
enhanced.description: Massively increases projectile velocity, substantially increases reload speed.

perks.name: Heal Clip
perks.description: Reloading shortly after dealing a final blow grants Cure to you and your nearby allies.

enhanced.name: Heal Clip
enhanced.description: Reloading after dealing a final blow grants Cure to you and your nearby allies. You have additional time to perform the reload.

perks.name: Loose Change

enhanced.name: Loose Change
enhanced.description: Applying an elemental debuff to a target increases this weapon's reload speed, aim assist, and movement while aiming down sights for an improved duration.

enhanced.name: Auto-Loading Holster

perks.name: Incandescent
perks.description:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

enhanced.name: Incandescent
enhanced.description:
Defeating a target spreads a longer lasting scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

enhanced.name: Binary Orbit
enhanced.description: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for an improved duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.

enhanced.name: Reverberation
